name: print-social-poster-lime-black-event-sticker-accents
title: Lime-green event poster with sticker accents and smiley icon
whatItIs: A companion lime-green poster from the same agency system, announcing a 'Creative Talkshow' event with a black card, scalloped notch, orange/purple sticker badges, and a simple smiley-face icon.
whatItMeans: Reusing the same lime/black/sticker system for an event announcement (rather than a service list) shows how the visual language scales from general branding to a specific promo.
techniques: reuse an established sticker-badge and scalloped-card system for a new specific message (event promo)
add a simple smiley icon as a friendly focal accent within an otherwise typographic layout
balance event logistics (date, time, RSVP) in evenly weighted sticker badges for quick scanning

vocabulary.definition: applying an established visual language (shapes, colors, badges) consistently across different specific pieces of content
